name: POFM, tests de sélection des équipes de France (Animath)
files: files.tsv lists every local copy with the URL it was downloaded from
what_it_is: The tests that select the French teams for the international competitions (IMO, EGMO, RMM,
Balkans, JBMO), five or six a year. Some years have separate junior and senior tests in
February. Most tests have a corrigé; seven tests (eight files) from 2012-2013 to 2016-2017 do not.

level.senior: IMO team selection, 4 hours, usually 3 or 4 problems. Expect most of it at Terminale, four or five stars, and some beyond the programme.
level.junior: Junior tests select for the JBMO and are for collège and seconde students.

how_it_was_enumerated: The page at ?page_id=479 was fetched once on 2026-09-30 and every PDF link downloaded, 137 files.
The March 2018 test is hosted at igm.univ-mlv.fr, its local copies start with juge_.
